title: SETTINGS FIRST TAB IS GAME, NOT DISPLAY
why: Menu map c-30: the first Settings tab was called Display but holds every section, with a Display section inside it. Renamed Game. No setting moved or removed.
now: The first tab in Settings now reads Game. The Display section inside it keeps its name.

edits.replacement: var T=[['display','GAME'],['rec','SEND PLAY DATA']];   // v28.xx (cw-settab), c-30 menu map: the first Settings tab was called DISPLAY but holds every section (the raid, audio, controls, controller, display, accessibility), so Display sat inside Display. It is the game tab now; the Display section keeps its name.
